CustomField.description: Count of Checklist_Item__c rows under this checklist. A WRITABLE NUMBER MAINTAINED BY APEX, NOT A ROLL-UP SUMMARY - that is a settled decision, not an oversight. A roll-up summary is not writable, which would break every seed script and TestDataFactory path that assigns these counters directly, and editable=true FLS on a roll-up summary fails the deploy outright. The sibling counters Wire_Open_Risks__c and Tasks_Overdue__c cannot be roll-ups at all (one is conditional on two fields, the other is date-relative), so Apex is required regardless and running two mechanisms side by side would be strictly worse than one.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of items in this group. Recalculated automatically; do not edit.
